response.overview: This is Julianne James' second release since her return to porn (see Anal Brat) and what a difference between her Vivid days and now. As she says, she's nastier and she proves it here toward the end of this feature. It starts, as usual, with Rocco in Seymore's apartment. He has Shelene with him, plus a girl named Tanya. They cavort for a while, after which Seymore goes to his editing bay at the studio to show us a tape he got from some "Midwest amateurs". Unfortunately, these amateurs look suspiciously like Brazil, Laurie Cameron and Paul Morgan – which leads me to wonder about the next sequence with Meekah and an alleged soap opera star whose face is optically hidden. But the best is saved for last. Julianne does an extended – and possible awards-nominee – masturbation/tease scene, after which Ron Jeremy gets hard real fast and gives her the screwing of her life.
